definition: Michel Anne Frederic DeGraff (born 1963) is a Haitian creolist and a professor at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT).
details: His scholarship focuses on Creole studies and the role of language and linguistics for decolonization and liberation. He has advocated for the recognition of Haitian Creole as a full-fledged language.
story: Think of a lightbulb moment: the idea was always there, but someone had to point a finger at it. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. Once you see it, you cannot unsee it. That is Michel DeGraff — a small key that opens a big door.
